description: Defines the QuicNetworkBlackholeDetector class for detecting network blackholes and path degradation in QUIC protocol, including related delegate interface and internal state management.

classes.name: quic::QuicNetworkBlackholeDetector
classes.description: Detects network blackholes and path degradation, manages detection alarms, and notifies delegate callbacks.

classes.name: quic::QuicNetworkBlackholeDetector::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callback methods triggered upon detection events.

methods.name: QuicNetworkBlackholeDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing detector with delegate, arena, alarm factory, and context.

methods.name: StopDetection
methods.description: Stops all detection activities, optionally permanently.

methods.name: RestartDetection
methods.description: Restarts detection with specified deadlines for path degrading, blackhole, and MTU reduction.

methods.name: IsDetectionInProgress
methods.description: Checks if detection is currently active.

methods.name: UpdateAlarm
methods.description: Updates the alarm to trigger at the next deadline.
